title: Niels Holgersson's Wonderbare Reis
summary: "Niels Holgersson's Wonderbare Reis" by Selma Lagerlöf and Margaretha Meijboom is a children's book written in 1906. When wild geese fly overhead, Nils unexpectedly joins them on their journey north to Lapland.
